verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is built on a real browser (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit) and explicitly supports executing JS, waiting for dynamic content, full-page scrolling for infinite-scroll pages, and returning fully rendered HTML/markdown output, backed by both official docs and GitHub feature list. Community feedback corroborates it as a working scraping library for LLM pipelines. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark specifically verifying JS-heavy SPA rendering accuracy beyond vendor/GitHub claims.
